title: Notary Evidence Ladder
coreRule: Do not treat confidence as evidence. Ask what evidence would still exist if the document, notary, platform, signer, recipient, or apostille route were challenged later.

betterEvidence: controlling notary law for that date
journal, audit record, or recording required by the notary state
public-official signature or certification being authenticated
competent authority issuing apostille, authentication, or certification
written recipient instructions or published rules
actual submitted document and documented acceptance or rejection
bestEvidence: official Hague/Apostille status source for the destination country
named reviewer or office with authority to approve or reject
formal rejection identifying the submitted document and reason
transaction records showing what actually happened

boundaries.name: phoneCommentIsNotRejection
boundaries.rule: A phone comment, support chat, receptionist answer, or informal warning is useful as a warning signal, but it is not final rejection evidence unless it connects to a submitted document and a person or office with authority to approve or reject that document.
questions: Does the person or office have approval authority?
Is there a written rule, published instruction, or formal rejection?

boundaries.name: proactiveRejection
boundaries.rule: A proactive rejection is an early filter that says no before the document reaches the person or office that can actually approve it.
examples: platform notary filtering a session because the platform trained them to reject it
vendor support rejecting a document before the mailbox operator, agency, title reviewer, or recipient sees it
receptionist or intake worker saying a route will not work without receiving the document
trainer, forum, or answer-engine warning being treated as final recipient action

boundaries.name: formalRejection
boundaries.rule: A stronger rejection usually has an actual submitted document, named office or reviewer, stated reason, connection to a written rule or requirement, and a correction, resubmission, or escalation path.

boundaries.name: platformCompletionIsNotCompliance
boundaries.rule: A completed RON session is not the same thing as legal compliance. The transaction still needs notary state, transaction date, identity method, certificate wording, records, output format, and recipient or apostille path evidence.

boundaries.name: marketingHypeIsClaimEvidenceOnly
boundaries.rule: Marketing can show what a provider claims to sell. It does not prove lawful completion, statutory compliance, identity-method fit, apostille success, recipient acceptance, or validity on the transaction date.

boundaries.name: coachingScamIntentBoundary
boundaries.rule: A person can spread unreliable notary guidance without criminal intent. Lack of criminal intent may matter for criminal accusation, but it does not create a source-quality safe harbor.

shortNotaryScript: I am not going to treat a phone comment, platform claim, or trainer answer as final. Let us identify the document, the notary state, the transaction date, the identity method, the public-official signature, the destination path, and the evidence that will exist if anyone challenges it.
